questions.stem_latex: After completing a numeracy test ($\%$), Hazel achieved a $z$-score of $-1$.

parts.label: a
parts.latex: How does Hazel's result compare with those of her peers? Explain your answer in terms of the mean and standard deviation.

parts.label: b
parts.latex: If the mean test mark was 81 and the standard deviation was 3, calculate Hazel's actual mark.

In the region of a tropical forest, 96 rare birds were captured, tagged and released. Five months later, 72 birds were recaptured from the same region and it was found that 18 of these birds had previously been tagged. Use the 'capture-recapture' method to give an estimate of the number of rare birds in this region of the forest.

questions.stem_latex:
Jo delivered catalogues as a job during her summer holidays.

She was paid a rate of $\$20$ per 1000 catalogues.

On an average day she delivered 4 catalogues to each residence along 45 city blocks.

Each block had on average 40 residences to receive catalogues.

parts.label: a
parts.latex: What would she have been paid for a week where she worked on 3 days?

parts.label: b
parts.latex: It took her on average 12 minutes to cover each block. What hourly rate of pay would be equivalent to her piecework pay rate?

What is the time difference, to the nearest minute, between Sydney and Tokyo?

notes: Digital file of 90 pages: pp0-44 are the blank question paper (p44 is the Section I answer sheet), pp45-89 repeat the paper annotated with handwritten worked solutions (bundled solutions; no marking criteria, so marks_breakdown is null). Section I 15 marks, Section II 85 marks (Q16-Q37). Cover says Section II 'Attempt Questions 16 - 38' and the booklet 1 cover says 'Booklet 3 - Questions 31-37' (Q31 is in Booklet 2); the paper ends at Q37. Printed typos kept: Q24(b) 'pain the ceiling'; Q25 'What time does she arrives'. Q24(b) is worded differently in the annotated solution copy ('Calculate the labour cost to paint the ceiling if two coats of paint are required'); the question-paper wording is used, and the solution gives $310 (less than the $350 saved). Q8 options use mu/sigma in the question copy but x-bar/s in the solution copy. Solution working issues transcribed as written: Q18(a) shows 3x4x4.5x40 = 21600 (should read 45, i.e. 3x4x45x40); Q23(a) answers '1.125 kW' (an energy in kWh; 4050 kJ) rather than kilojoules; Q24(a) gives 5.375 m and 4.625 m (not rounded to 2 dp); Q31(c) states outlier boundary 'above 126' after computing 125. Q5 option graphs are cropped as option figures. Blank answer boxes (Q20, Q36(b)) are not figures. Handwritten sketches on the normal curve (Q27) and cut annotation on Q26 are not cropped as solution figures. Old syllabus / standard_topic left empty as instructed.
